reviews.review_msg: Great experience! I learned a lot about Italian film & reading them as texts. Prof is passionate, caring & available. Films & discussions are engaging if you talk (a MUST). Short, informal writing tasks (not hard) until the 8 p. final paper. His process based approach was great for me, but probably not if you're lazy or having AI write your papers.

Eng student, took course as an elective. Biggest mistake EVER. Weekly films took many tries to understand. Final paper ~3000 words sucked, due after final exams which is ridiculous. Lectures sucked, prof doesn't allow electronics during class. Feedback given only on Zoom. Interest in Italian film hit new low. Don't take unless you have free time.

I'm really liking this unique class on art & the humanities. The prof uses Italian cinema to teach critical thinking and reading films as texts. It is nice to take a course like this in the first year. He's very approachable and helpful and is a fair marker. Take advantage of office hours on Zoom for extra help. The feedback is great.

I've taken all of the classes Prof. Evan Freeman has to offer at SFU and would've kept taking more if it was possible. His classes are discussion heavy but he is accommodating for those who aren't the biggest talkers. His joy for his subject and teaching makes his classes incredibly enjoyable and he is easy to speak to if you encounter troubles.

one of the best profs ive ever had... he was extremely passionate and personable.. his lectures were very interesting and he definitely made a 3 hour class pass by quickly. He's one of those profs that have so much knowledge and excitement about what they're teaching, which makes it very easy to stay engaged and actually want to do a good job

Loved Evan!! He was extremely passionate, which made the subject all the more interesting. He posts assigned readings for the objects you learn about, but as long as you pay attention & take notes during lectures, you don't need to read anything. Slides are posted, have accompanying study questions, & the online quizzes are straightforward.
